preamble: Fronting of the uvular ejective [qʼ] to the velar ejective [kʼ], keeping glottalization. In Yucatecan and Cholan-Tseltalan Mayan, Proto-Mayan *qʼ merged with *kʼ together with the parallel merger of plain *q with *k, while Kʼicheʼan and Mamean keep the uvulars. In Laz (Kartvelian), *qʼ became kʼ after another ejective in a cluster (tʼqʼ > tʼkʼ, tʃʼqʼ > tʃʼkʼ) in Vitse-Arkabi, Khopa and Chkhala, whereas Atina, Vizha and Artasheni drop it there.

examples.note: Merger of the uvular and velar ejectives in Yucatec Maya, Lacandon, Itzaʼ, Chol and Tzeltal, parallel to *q > k; Kʼicheʼ and Mam keep /qʼ/.
Atina/Vizha/Artasheni მტა mta; Megrelian ტყა tʼqʼa; Georgian ტყე tʼqʼe.
